svg.title: SQL Server CDC replication on Azure VMs with Microsoft Fabric Pipeline
svg.desc: Planned lab topology from deploy.py and fabric.py. An Azure resource group contains a virtual network, Bastion, two private SQL Server VMs, NAT gateway, Key Vault, and dedicated Fabric F8 capacity. Fabric SaaS is outside the virtual network. Its pipeline uses a managed VNet data gateway in a delegated subnet to connect to both SQL servers over TLS on port 1433. Administrator browser access uses HTTPS to Bastion and private RDP to each VM. There is no direct source-to-target SQL connection. Batch order is prepare, copy, atomic apply, then source acknowledgement. Resource names with suffix are templates, not live identifiers.
svg.text: SQL Server CDC replication with Microsoft Fabric

nsg-sqlsync attached to both VM NICs

Not an inbound SQL / RDP path
Workspace is a Fabric SaaS object
Not a VM inside the VNet
Fabric SaaS | Outside the Azure VNet
Official Azure / Microsoft Fabric icons | Documented lab topology, not live resource status | <suffix> = configured LAB_SUFFIX
One-way data copy, not HA / DR. Network lines show access paths; the numbered steps show CDC processing order. POC only.
